messages:
katie: Quick sync — finalizing the onboarding pilot readiness checklist. Need concrete acceptance criteria for SLA/SLOs, docs, support/rotation, monitoring alerts/runbooks, and pricing telemetry. Who can own each surface?

devin: I can own SLO/SLA defs + monitoring. Proposal: hosted pilot p99 latency <= 300ms, enterprise pilot p99 <= 150ms, availability target 99.9% for pilot customers. MTTD alert target = 5m.

anita: Docs owner here. I'll produce the customer-facing onboarding guide, internal runbook, and API schema notes. ETA: EOD Wed if I have the exact SLO wording + approved error messages.

samir: Support/ops: I'll own the oncall rota and triage playbook for first 2 weeks. Request: a dedicated 'onboard-pilot' PagerDuty schedule and incident channel.

leo: Pricing/FinOps: I'll add per-route metering and a pilot flag. Need the event schema to include "onboard_pilot=true" and token-level tags for reporting. Will draft invoice-preview flow.

devin: For alerts I'm drafting two starters (will refine):
```
# alerts (PromQL)
sum(rate(redwood_errors_total[5m])) by (route) > 5
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.3
```
I'll post these to infra-alerts and wire to the oncall rota.

katie: Owners so far: SLOs/monitoring = devin, docs = anita, support = samir, pricing = leo. Can we get legal/compliance review on data handling? @maria can you take that?

maria: I can review. I'll check data retention, KMS/HSM usage for Private, and PII flow by Thu. Need the data retention table + example logs.

anita: Doc checklist I'm adding to the draft: internal runbook (TL;DR triage steps), customer "what to expect" page, rollback steps, sample API responses, and a short changelog. Draft link: https://redwood.docs/onboard-pilot-draft

samir: We'll create the slack channel `#onboard-pilot-ops` and a PagerDuty schedule. Suggest a 48h smoke of the paid onboarding path before ramping traffic.

devin: Operational controls: freeze infra/config changes 2h before cut, enable canary at 5% traffic, fallback policy to last-stable model variant on errors. I'll add the feature toggles to infra repo.

leo: Finance note: apply an explicit "pilot discount" entitlement and surface an invoice preview for pilot customers. Also need telemetry to export pilot usage to billing CSVs.

katie: Great. Action items: please add your tasks to the launch board, specify green/red gating criteria, and set owners for each bullet by EOD tomorrow. I'll run a final gating sync Fri 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:
